headline: Gulf countries on alert after US bombings on the Iranian island of Qeshm
summary: Bahrain said its air defences intercepted attacks launched from Iran early on Wednesday. Gulf countries are on alert following US bombing on the Iranian island of Qeshm.
why: The Gulf region hosts major oil production and shipping routes, so military escalation there is closely watched by energy markets.
why_moved: US strikes on Iranian territory and reported Iranian-launched attacks on Gulf states raise the risk of wider regional conflict. Such escalation typically lifts oil prices on supply-risk concerns.
original_headline: Países del Golfo en alerta tras bombardeos de Estados Unidos en la isla iraní de Qeshm
